mapper.sql: id, event_key, event_type, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error, lease_owner, lease_until, lease_version, created_time, updated_time, applied_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_comment_inbox (event_key, event_type, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_version, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_comment_inbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_comment_inbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_version = lease_version + 1, updated_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= #{now}))
UPDATE t_comment_inbox SET payload = '', updated_time = NOW() WHERE status = 'APPLIED' AND applied_time < #{cutoff} AND payload != '' ORDER BY applied_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
